title: CHETR: A Typed Neuro-Symbolic Agent for Mechanistic Drug Repurposing

contributions.purpose: 在类型化知识图上规划机制路径
contributions.mechanism: LLM生成类型化metapath,受约束枚举器(GraphBLAS前沿)执行
contributions.evaluation: 定性;仅toy micro-example演示无实证
contributions.source_quote: Typed neuro-symbolic planning. An LLM planner produces typed metapaths over a typed KG, executed by a constrained enumerator that preserves mechanistic semantics.

contributions.purpose: 为机制假设提供可审计证书
contributions.mechanism: MCS(反事实路径消融+IV包络+扰动一致性)+TFI(暴露边际/BBB-Pgp-BCRP/DDI)
contributions.source_quote: Auditable mechanism certificates. MCS combines: (i) counterfactual path ablations, (ii) IV envelopes (instrumental-variables bounds), and (iii) perturbation concordance.

contributions.purpose: 给出理论保证防止虚假机制主导
contributions.mechanism: 定理1忠实性下界、定理2类型化d-分离可靠性
contributions.source_quote: We prove a faithfulness lower bound (Theorem 1) that links rank drops to removal of mechanism-critical edges, and a typed soundness condition (Theorem 2).

contributions.purpose: 提供无需湿实验的可复现评估协议
contributions.mechanism: 时间切分+冻结KG+SHA-256校验和治理+CI泄漏计数
contributions.evaluation: 定性;声称零泄漏可复现micro-example数值
contributions.source_quote: Leakage–safe, experiment–free evaluation. A time–split protocol (frozen KG; prospective evidence trackers) and deterministic certificates allow end-to-end reproduction without wet-lab execution.

self_declared_provenance.quote: In repurposing, correlation-first systems (signature reversal, embeddings, unconstrained path scores) lack explicit auditing and translational gating. CHETR differs by providing (i) typed planning and execution, (ii) formal guarantees, and (iii) explicit certificates.

notes: 非实证类适配问题:全文theory-first、experiment-free,唯一'验证'是第6节手工micro-example,输入数值(π=0.9/0.8/0.7,dRev=0.6,IV=0.55,Pert=0.5)为人造占位/自称catalogue-derived surrogates,无真实数据。数据红旗:证书数字全部手搓。desk-reject:缺失Agents4Science必需的完整Paper/AI Involvement Checklist(仅有AI Contribution Disclosure)。责任声明误引'NeurIPS Code of Ethics'(投稿venue为Agents4Science)。参考文献极简且疑部分虚构(如[5] de Bruin & Schafer isotonic回归JMLR2005)。补充材料withheld至review后。四元组evaluation栏因无实证多为定性。
